result.instructions: Tools for Featurebase, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which feature requests have the most upvotes?"; "Search our feedback for posts about SSO and show their statuses."; "List the boards in our workspace.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Featurebase data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run featurebase_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run featurebase_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run featurebase_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. featurebase_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: featurebase_list_boards
tools.title: List boards
tools.description: List the feedback boards in the workspace with their ids. Call this first to find a board_id for posts. GET /v2/boards.

tools.name: featurebase_get_board
tools.title: Get board
tools.description: Get one feedback board by id. GET /v2/boards/{id}.

tools.name: featurebase_list_post_statuses
tools.title: List post statuses
tools.description: List post statuses (for example planned, in progress, shipped) with their ids. Use the ids to filter posts. GET /v2/post_statuses.

tools.name: featurebase_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List feedback posts, newest first by default, with optional board, status and text filters. Cursor-paged. GET /v2/posts. Insights are not returned here.

board_id.description: Only posts on this board id.

status_id.description: Only posts with this status id.

q.description: Filter posts whose title or content matches this text.

kind.description: 'issue' (default) for work items, 'record' for customer submissions.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: featurebase_search_posts
tools.title: Search posts
tools.description: Full-text search across post titles and content, ranked by relevance unless a sort is given. Cursor-paged. POST /v2/posts/search (read only).

search.description: Plain-text search across titles and content. No operators. Omit it to browse with sort only.

sort.description: Sort field and direction. Default is relevance when search is set, else createdAt:desc.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: featurebase_get_post
tools.title: Get post
tools.description: Get one feedback post with its status, board, tags and vote count. GET /v2/posts/{id}.

post_id.description: Post id, from featurebase_list_posts or featurebase_search_posts.

tools.name: featurebase_search_comments
tools.title: Search comments
tools.description: Full-text search across comment content, ranked by relevance unless a sort is given. Cursor-paged. POST /v2/comments/search (read only).

search.description: Plain-text search across comment content. No operators. Omit it to browse with sort only.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: featurebase_get_comment
tools.title: Get comment
tools.description: Get one comment by id. GET /v2/comments/{id}.

tools.name: featurebase_create_post
tools.title: Create post
tools.description: Create a feedback post on a board. Writes a new post in the workspace. POST /v2/posts. Not idempotent: a retry can create a duplicate.

board_id.description: Board id from featurebase_list_boards. Optional in the API types; omit it to use the API's default board.

content.description: Post body, plain text or HTML.

tools.name: featurebase_create_comment
tools.title: Create comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a feedback post, optionally as a reply. POST /v2/comments. Not idempotent: a retry can create a duplicate.

post_id.description: Post id, from featurebase_list_posts or featurebase_search_posts.

is_private.description: true makes the comment visible only to admins.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Featurebase
prompts.description: What you can do with Featurebase here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_existing_requests_before_a_new_post
prompts.title: Find existing requests before a new post
prompts.description: Search post titles and content for a topic. Open a matching post to read its status, board, tags and vote count.

prompts.name: review_posts_by_board_and_status
prompts.title: Review posts by board and status
prompts.description: List the boards and post statuses of the workspace. Filter the posts of one board by status, such as planned or shipped.

prompts.name: search_comments_for_a_topic
prompts.title: Search comments for a topic
prompts.description: Search comment text across the workspace for a topic. Open one comment by its id to read it in full.

prompts.name: create_a_feedback_post_on_a_board
prompts.title: Create a feedback post on a board
prompts.description: List the boards to find the right one. Create a post on it. A retry can create a duplicate post, so search first.

prompts.name: reply_to_a_post_with_a_comment
prompts.title: Reply to a post with a comment
prompts.description: Open the post first. Add a comment, optionally as a reply. A retry can add a duplicate comment.
